description.before: Remote Vermont woodland. A two-lane road threads the trees toward the town of Jericho; a longer private drive climbs north-east to Nevermore Academy. Fog sits in the hollows even in dry weather. The woods are old, the oaks older, and the academy's stone does not belong to New England so much as it was willed into it.
description.after: Remote Vermont woodland. A two-lane road threads the trees toward the town of Jericho; a longer private drive climbs north-east to Nevermore Academy. Fog sits in the hollows even in dry weather. The woods are old, the oaks older, and the academy's stone does not belong to New England so much as it was willed into it. Ridge Woods occupy the higher academy approach; Blackwater Hollow is the lower townward drainage; Western Old Woods lie beyond the academy’s western boundary. The maintained town-to-academy road and the old woodland tracks are separate routes.

description.before: A small Vermont town at the foot of the wooded ridge. Storefronts, a diner, a sheriff who has learned which questions not to ask about the school on the hill. Students come down on sanctioned trips and come back before dark, officially.
description.after: A small Vermont town at the foot of the wooded ridge. Storefronts, a diner, a sheriff who has learned which questions not to ask about the school on the hill. Students come down on sanctioned trips and come back before dark, officially. An old track leaves toward Old Stone Bridge and the abandoned mill in Blackwater Hollow.

modelMemory.before: Five floors: Threshold, First Rite, Second Rite, Union, Covenant. Each ritual door is a room separate from its performance chamber. Doors open only on genuine completed desire — not performance, not coercion. No false-turning room; a failed attempt stays on that floor. Morticia and Gomez descended in youth. Thing has mapped every mouth.
modelMemory.after: Physical order: Threshold, First Rite, Second Rite, Union, Covenant. Chamber precedes its progression door on each ritual level. Threshold and First Rite form the initial connected group; later stages are separate map roots to prevent parent-traversal bypasses. Their physical setting remains underground beneath Nevermore. Three concealed surface entrances require explicit reveal edits; narrative discovery does not change stored links. Preserve the existing stage requirements. No failed attempt relocates the party to another stage.

awarenessSummary.after: Arrival hall with portrait, preparation alcove and the route to First Rite.

description.before: The rest of the arrival chamber after the Portrait. Blue flame, warm stone underfoot, nowhere to sit that is not a ledge. People stand here flushed and decide whether to go on.
description.after: The main arrival chamber immediately inside the Iron Gate. Blue-flame sconces mark an open stone floor and a low waiting ledge. The Living Portrait hangs on the left-hand wall; the Vestment Alcove opens to one side. A descending passage leads toward the First Rite chamber. The entrance mouths lie beyond the gate behind you.

description.before: The first ritual floor. Stone warmer than the Threshold. One iron door, one chamber behind it, a short passage once the door has opened.
description.after: The first ritual level below Threshold Hall: a landing opening into the Chamber of Caresses, then the Door of First Touch at its far exit. Beyond that door the Breath Passage descends to Second Rite.

before.label: the Breath Passage, once the door has opened

modelMemory.before: Tender, exploratory, kissing, hands. Completion here is what opens the Breath Passage.
modelMemory.after: The First Rite takes place here before the Door of First Touch. Apply the attached First Rite requirements. Completion satisfies that exit door, leading to Breath Passage; it does not satisfy any later stage.

description.before: A massive iron door. Bas-relief of tender, exploratory caresses and passionate kissing. The runes warm when someone stands close with actual intent. The chamber beyond is visible only as heat through the seams until the door accepts the rite.
description.after: A massive iron door at the far end of the Chamber of Caresses. Its carved relief belongs to the first stage. The runes warm in response to completion within this chamber; beyond the threshold lies the descending Breath Passage.

after.label: Progression door: Door of First Touch

modelMemory.before: The lock is the act: authentic desire, emotional intensity, mutual completion. Half-hearted, coerced, or mechanical attempts fail with illusions or petty curses. Success opens this door with a resonant, almost orgasmic groan. Until then the link into the chamber is blocked.
modelMemory.after: This is the exit from the first chamber, not its entrance. The established First Rite requirement is completed in the Chamber of Caresses. Success satisfies this door only. The onward connection leads to Breath Passage and begins blocked; the map owner must explicitly make it available. Retreat within First Rite remains possible.

before.label: back to the Door of Worship

modelMemory.before: Mutual oral worship, heated embraces. Completion opens the way to the Echo Niche.
modelMemory.after: The Second Rite takes place here before the Door of Worship. Completion satisfies that exit door toward the Chamber of Harmonies. Echo Niche is an optional side recess, freely accessible from this chamber; entering it is not another stage.

description.before: The second iron door. Pictograms of mutual oral worship and bodies locked together. The stone here has a pulse you can mistake for your own.
description.after: The second carved iron door stands at the far exit of the Chamber of Mouths. The room and its side recess lie behind it; the stair toward the Chamber of Harmonies lies beyond. Warmth gathers at the seams.

modelMemory.before: Same lock as every door: genuine desire and mutual completion. Escalation is required. Until satisfied, the chamber link stays blocked.
modelMemory.after: This is the exit from Second Rite. The established Second Rite requirement is completed in the Chamber of Mouths. Success satisfies this door only. Its connection to the Chamber of Harmonies begins blocked and needs an explicit owner edit. Echo Niche is a side recess, not the route onward.

modelMemory.before: Synchronized penetration, shared climax, mutual attention. Generous endowment is assumed in the reliefs. This floor does not grant the altar boon.
modelMemory.after: The Union stage takes place here before the Door of Three. Apply its attached requirements. Completion satisfies that exit door toward Approach Hall; the final boon belongs at the Obsidian Altar. Vestment Alcove is upstairs beside Threshold Hall, not on this level.

description.before: The third iron door. Three bodies in the carving, configured and reconfigured as the eye moves. Heat comes through the seams in waves.
description.after: The third carved iron door occupies the far exit of the Chamber of Harmonies. Its three-figure relief faces into the chamber. Beyond the sealed threshold, a descending stair leads to Covenant and Approach Hall.

before.label: back up to the Echo Niche

modelMemory.before: Lock is a completed, harmonious rite matching the carving. Often two women and one man; the magic wants genuine arrangement, not a headcount. Chamber link blocked until then.
modelMemory.after: This is the exit from Union. The established Union requirement is completed in the Chamber of Harmonies. Success satisfies the Door of Three and permits the descent to Approach Hall after the owner opens its link. Physical admission to Covenant does not itself grant the altar boon.

modelMemory.before: Mouths: Nightshade stair from the Poe statue, family tunnel from Ravencroft's iron maiden, one crawlspace Thing mapped from the dorm vents. The Portrait is the gentlest trial and it is not optional if you look at it.
modelMemory.after: Arrival floor only. Three entrance mouths converge at the Iron Gate and Threshold Hall. The Living Portrait occupies the left wall inside; the Vestment Alcove branches from the hall. First Rite is below. No progression rite is performed on this floor.

description.before: The first iron gate after the last honest stair. Runes along the arch. Beyond it the chamber opens; behind it, whichever mouth you used.
description.after: An ordinary iron gate beneath a rune-cut arch, between the three arrival mouths and Threshold Hall. Beyond it the hall opens, with the Living Portrait on the left. This entrance gate is distinct from the three progression doors deeper below.
